{{Top|leg}}
The '''Homd-Resa''' was one of the few [[Senali]] clans that were aggressive. Members of the clan were often quite visibly seen patrolling their [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] territory with martial persistence. The Homd-Resa clan once attacked the [[Nali-Erun clan]], destroying the Nali-Erun settlements in a statement of dominance.
